relationships.evidence_quote: rTMS treatment promoted a partial reversal of mechanical allodynia and total reversal of thermal hyperalgesia induced by CCI.

key_findings: Eight daily sessions of rTMS partially reversed mechanical allodynia and fully reversed thermal hyperalgesia in rats with sciatic nerve chronic constriction injury.
rTMS raised BDNF, TNF-alpha and IL-10 levels in the prefrontal cortex, suggesting cortical neuroinflammatory and neuroplastic changes accompany the analgesia.
